errors.description: Errors is the total API requests that resulted in error responses

inflight.description: Inflight are the number of API requests currently being served

level.description: Level is the active API level this server implements

total.description: Total is the total API requests received since start

current.description: Current indicates if it was seen recently and fully caught up

lag.description: Lag is how many operations behind it is

offline.description: Offline indicates if it has not been seen recently

peer.description: Peer is the unique ID for the peer

allow_atomic.description: AllowAtomicPublish allows atomic batch publishing into the stream.

allow_direct.description: Allow higher performance, direct access to get individual messages. E.g. KeyValue

allow_msg_counter.description: AllowMsgCounter allows a stream to use (only) counter CRDTs.

allow_msg_schedules.description: AllowMsgSchedules allows the scheduling of messages.

allow_msg_ttl.description: AllowMsgTTL allows header initiated per-message TTLs. If disabled, then the `NATS-TTL` header will be ignored.

allow_rollup_hdrs.description: AllowRollup allows messages to be placed into the system and purge all older messages using a special msg header.

consumer_limits.description: The following defaults will apply to consumers when created against this stream, unless overridden manually. TODO(nat): Can/should we name these better?

inactive_threshold.$comment: nanoseconds depicting a duration in time

deny_delete.description: DenyDelete will restrict the ability to delete messages.

deny_purge.description: DenyPurge will restrict the ability to purge messages.

discard_new_per_subject.description: Allow KV like semantics to also discard new on a per subject basis

duplicate_window.$comment: nanoseconds depicting a duration in time

max_age.$comment: nanoseconds depicting a duration in time

metadata.description: Metadata is additional metadata for the Stream.

mirror_direct.description: Allow higher performance and unified direct access for mirrors as well.

persist_mode.description: PersistMode allows to opt-in to different persistence mode settings.

republish.description: Allow republish of the message after being sequenced and stored.

sealed.description: Sealed will seal a stream so no messages can get out or in.

subject_delete_marker_ttl.description: SubjectDeleteMarkerTTL sets the TTL of delete marker messages left behind by subject delete markers.
subject_delete_marker_ttl.$comment: nanoseconds depicting a duration in time

subject_transform.description: Allow applying a subject transform to incoming messages before doing anything else

template_owner.description: Deprecated: stream templates are deprecated and will be removed in a future version.
